description: Two dimensional walker: four trigger inputs move a point around a grid, and its position is put out as address voltages

params.text: Adds to the X position of every step of the walk, 0 to 31
Adds to the Y position of every step of the walk, 0 to 31
Sets how many places the walk covers in X before it wraps around, 2 to 32
Sets how many places the walk covers in Y before it wraps around, 2 to 32
Sets the address space the positions are spread over, 2 to 32; use 16 to address TD4

inputs.text: A rising edge sends the point back to the start of its walk and blocks the step inputs for 1ms
A trigger moves the point one place towards lower X, wrapping around to the far end of the X length
A trigger moves the point one place towards higher X, wrapping around to the start of the X length
A trigger moves the point one place towards higher Y, wrapping around to the start of the Y length
A trigger moves the point one place towards lower Y, wrapping around to the far end of the Y length
Sets the start of the X walk, the X length spread over 0-10V, and overrides the Start X knob while patched
Sets the start of the Y walk, the Y length spread over 0-10V, and overrides the Start Y knob while patched

outputs.text: Both positions folded into one address, the Y position times the Y length plus the X position, spread over 0-10V
The X position as a voltage, the address space spread over 0-10V
The Y position as a voltage, the address space spread over 0-10V

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.2: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.3: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.4: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
